Leonard,

Done. 33 companies are logged in "Q4 commitments log" in the Q4 commitments folder: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/3f148431673609df/edit
Everyone who was waiting has a written answer, and each contact is now in Contacts.

KEEPING (Arthur's keep-running list):
- Vaultline: nightly DB backups, $19/month from the Oct 12 renewal
- Certwell: API domain SSL cert, $89/year, renews before it lapses Oct 20
- Pingwise: night pager, $29/month on Team from Nov 1 (told them not to downgrade)
None of the three needs a new signature.

WAITING ON YOU OR ARTHUR TO SIGN (cards are on the Harmony Games board To Do list):
With ESG first (intake email sent for each one):
- Kinetic Arcade: Japan/Korea publishing LOI with 12 months' exclusivity. Sign by Oct 20
- Lumencloud: $25k credits, 36-month agreement. Sign by Oct 31
- Bundlehouse: holiday bundle; the agreement licenses Domino Delights' name and art for 18 months. Sign by Nov 1
- Lanternfly: SEA publishing for Domino Delights, 2-year exclusive. No date given
No ESG review needed:
- Playfuse: mutual NDA on ESG's template. Before the Oct 8 call
- Orbit Store: November featuring agreement, accepted in their portal. By Oct 24
- Markward: click-through terms for the free brand-monitoring tier. No date

Everything else:
- Ended (cash before January), 11: Brightlane, Ascendo, Lingora, Panelpulse, Pixel Harbor (Bay Area booth deposit), Soundvault, Framewell, Wishwave (partner-booked travel counts as cash, per your Monday change), Streamcast, plus Reviewly and Clipforge. Those last two were trials that turn paid on Oct 20 and Oct 16. Clipforge's cancellation went to billing@paylane.io in writing, as their notice requires.
- Parked for the Jan 5 review, 11: Glyphworks, Quillcraft, Loopnote, Driftwood Audio, Benchmarkly, Tilecast, Echohall, Retainly, Cloudlark, Pressbeam, Hootline. Each has a reminder on my calendar for Jan 5.
- Already answered: Motive Forge. Arthur passed on Sep 19, so I didn't write to them again.
- Left off the list: Spotlight Fest and Nova Rewards were cold pitches nobody answered, and Nova has since withdrawn.

Fred
